FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tax Event Extensibility
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds machinery to let submods intercept and redirect tax events.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds ITaxDeliveryInterceptor interface to let submods redirect tax events, or intercept them at time of delivery

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Backend code updates to clean things up a bit.

patchNoteLines.li: Cleans up some code to more properly encapsulate many fields

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: New Scrollbars
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates all scrollbars in Empire windows to use flat rectangles instead of the default rounded shape, to be more in line with Empire's general UI design.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds new ScrollUtil class to handle the new scrollbars

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Empire Codex
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds the framework for the Empire Codex, meant to be an in-game resource similar to Civilization's Civilopedia.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds framework for the Empire Codex

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Military Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates military raids to enable additional military functionality.

patchNoteLines.li: Allows multiple raids to hit the same settlement at once
Allows multiple settlements to be raided at once
Adds backend infrastructure for a submod to implement manual battles for offensive raids

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Codex: Add Resources
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds resources to the Empire Codex.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds Resources to the Empire Codex.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor backend change to how bonuses are colorized, which should hopefully produce more consistent bonus coloration throughout the UI.

patchNoteLines.li: Change TextUtil.ColorizeAdditiveBonus and ColorizeMultiplierBonus to return strings instead of TaggedStrings

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some extensibility changes for the manage units/squads/fire support windows to make it easier for submods to interject their own windows.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds MilitaryWindowRegistry to make it easier for submods to intercept the existing Manage Units/Squads/Fire Support windows and draw their own

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tax Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Add guards against the time between taxes being 0.

patchNoteLines.li: Prevent the user from setting the time between taxes to 0. If it somehow becomes 0 anyways, log a warning and set it to 1.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Codex Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a few more entries to the Empire Codex.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds Codex entries for Resource Production, Production Snapshots, Resource Tithing, Worker Overmax, Difficulty Settings, Attack Frequency, Battle Simulation, Battle Simulation Modifiers, and Military Cooldown

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Military Extensibility Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A few changes to make military units and squads more extensible.

patchNoteLines.li: Alters MilUnitFC, MilSquadFC, and MercenarySquadFC to be subclassable
Alters unit and squad saving to account for subclassing

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Policy Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: The first real balance pass. This patch updates many of the policies to (hopefully) smooth out the power level. Along with the shake-up comes a new feature: the ability to clear your chosen policies and select new ones, albeit for a cost.

patchNoteLines.li: Militaristic policy nerfed: 1.2 military efficiency -> 1.1, extra squad cost 20% -> 40%, military building upkeep reduction 100 -> 50, and the policy now carries an inherent -0.5 happiness per day. People generally don't like living in militaristic regimes, after all

Pacifist policy buff/nerfed: no longer immune to soldier deaths (no idea why that was even a thing); in exchange, the diplomatic envoy is slightly more likely to succeed, and the relation improvement range has been changed from 5-15 to 8-20

Egalitarian changed: removed happiness-based tax bonus as well as starting happiness penalty. Added 10% worker production bonus, 1 additional worker per level, -3 overmax workers, worker base cost increased by 10

Expansionist changed: no more free starting settlement, no more 50% discount once per year. Instead, all settlements are 25% cheaper, but start at 75% prosperity. Threat scaling increased by 10% as well
Technocratic nerfed: now carries a -10% penalty to base tax percentage
Slaver nerfed: -0.5 happiness and +0.5 unrest per day. You don't get to rely on slave labor for free, bucko (and the +2 workers per settlement level *is* quite strong)
Scorched Earth Doctrine buffed: building destruction chance 2x -> 1.25x, defending bonus 1.3x -> 1.5x, prosperity loss on victory 1.5x -> 1.2x
Added option to clear policy choices after they've already been chosen, for a cost that scales based on Empire size and prosperity
Some backend code updates.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More Backend Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes all fields that refer to a planet tile to use the actual PlanetTile type. Rimworld does technically allow for straight casting between int and PlanetTile, but you lose layer information when you do that. Empire actually does handle multiple layers (see orbital settlements), so switching over to using the actual PlanetTile type should protect against future errors.

patchNoteLines.li: Update to use actual PlanetTile type wherever appropriate

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Defense Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Currently, when setting up a manual defense battle, if an animal would spawn without a rider, then the mod logs an error and skips the animal. This update changes that; we now only log a warning, and then try to spawn the animal anyways.

patchNoteLines.li: Always spawn animals without riders in manual defense battles

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Backend Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A backend code update for event handling.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates events to have one of four phases, indicating at what stage of processing they're in. Makes event tracking more clear

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Caravan Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: The caravan list for the Empire NPC faction gets built too early in the loading process, resulting in an empty list until a taxday occurs. This patch delays the list assembly to make sure that it always correctly reflects the production of the Empire faction.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: the list of caravan traderkinds is assembled before faction-level production allocations are loaded, resulting in an empty caravan list until tax time

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Tax Tick Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor backend change to the tax tick processing.

patchNoteLines.li: Removes an overly-strict tax period guard in TaxTick() that blocked the debug action for instantly proccing taxes
